name: package_types_with_links
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.barcode, t.package_use, t.sequence, t.company_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_package_type_stock_putaway_rule_rel r WHERE r.stock_package_type_id = t.id) AS n_putaway_rules, (SELECT string_agg(r.stock_putaway_rule_id::text, ',' ORDER BY r.stock_putaway_rule_id) FROM stock_package_type_stock_putaway_rule_rel r WHERE r.stock_package_type_id = t.id) AS putaway_rule_ids, (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_package_type_stock_route_rel r WHERE r.stock_package_type_id = t.id) AS n_routes, (SELECT string_agg(r.stock_route_id::text, ',' ORDER BY r.stock_route_id) FROM stock_package_type_stock_route_rel r WHERE r.stock_package_type_id = t.id) AS route_ids FROM stock_package_type t

name: uom_relative_tree
source_sql: SELECT id, relative_uom_id, parent_path, factor, relative_factor, active, package_type_id, unece_code, sequence FROM uom_uom
